name: CO2 INCUBATOR
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-CO2-160 CO2 Incubator is an indispensable piece of equipment for advanced biotechnology, oncology, and neuroscience laboratories, providing an artificial, sterile in-vitro environment for mammalian tissue and cell culture growth. This Air Jacketed system utilizes highly accurate IR sensors to control CO2 concentrations and features built-in sterilization routines.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-CO2-160 CO2 Incubator is a microprocessor-controlled, air-jacketed cell culture system engineered to replicate the physiological in-vitro microenvironment required for mammalian cell, tissue and embryo viability. It maintains thermal uniformity (ambient+10°C to 60°C) via glass-wool insulation and an axial fan, controls 2–20% CO2 tension using a high-precision IR sensor, and sustains up to 95% relative humidity by evaporation from a bottom water reservoir. The dissolved CO2 equilibrates with sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3) in buffered media such as DMEM, RPMI-1640, MEM or Ham’s F-12—commonly supplemented with L-glutamine, HEPES, phenol red and fetal bovine serum—to maintain an extracellular pH of 7.2–7.4. Doctors and embryologists rely on this chamber for IVF embryo culture, while B.Sc/M.Sc students, PhD researchers and chemists use it to cultivate primary fibroblasts, cancer cell lines (HeLa, HEK293, SH-SY5Y, MCF-7), induced pluripotent stem cells, tumor spheroids, neural progenitor cells and tissue explants under ISO/ASTM-aligned protocols. A 0.3 µm HEPA inlet filter and seamless stainless steel 304 chamber with rounded corners minimize airborne particulates and biofilm formation, while selectable 90°C moist heat or 254 nm UV sterilization routines inactivate mycoplasma, bacteria, fungi and spores before and after critical assays.
sop: Verify that the incubator is connected to a 220 V 50 Hz supply and the chamber, shelves and door gaskets are clean and dry.
Fill the bottom humidity pan with sterile distilled or deionized water to the marked level, then close the outer door securely.
Switch ON the mains and allow the controller to complete its self-diagnostic display check.
Press the 'SET' button once to enter the temperature setpoint mode.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter (e.g., 37.0°C for mammalian cell culture).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value.
Press 'SET' repeatedly until the CO2 setpoint appears, then use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to set the required CO2 concentration (typically 2% to 20%, most commonly 5.0%).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value, then wait at least 30–60 minutes for temperature, CO2 and humidity readings to stabilize before loading cultures.
Before opening the inner glass door, disinfect gloved hands and all external surfaces with 70% ethanol or isopropanol; transfer flasks, plates or dishes quickly and close the door promptly.

Safety Precaution: Do not use volatile organic solvents, strong acids or flammable sterilants inside the chamber; if the 90°C moist heat sterilization cycle is selected, remove all heat-labile media, cultures and electronic sensors, and ensure the chamber is dry and the door is sealed before initiating the cycle.
features: Air jacketed construction with seamless Stainless Steel 304 chamber
Precise CO2 control using Thermal Conductivity / IR Sensor
90°C moist heat or UV sterilization (254nm) integration
0.3µ HEPA CO2 inlet filter shielding against contaminants
Microprocessor based PID controller with independent over-heat protection

specifications.Humidity System: Water filled at bottom tank (Air humidity up to 95%)
specifications.Sterilization: UV lamp or 90°C moist heat sterilization
specifications.Doors: Solid Outer w/ clamp handle & Toughened inner glass observation door
specifications.Temperature Control: Digital PID Controller (CO2, Temp, Humidity SV & PV display)
specifications.Alarms: CO2 variation, Temperature variation, Humidity variation, Door ajar
specifications.Target Applications: Tissue Cell Culture, IVF, Cancer Research, Neuroscience
